name: thimble
description: thimble for Claude Code: the `thimble` command reads and queries any files and keeps the code, inputs and source rows behind every value. Each card Claude saves is drawn under its reply and opens in a detail view that keeps the chat going; each citation opens the rows it cites. After each of Claude's messages an observer reads it with the whole session: it leaves notes for Claude, lights v when another view would help, and marks the terms the person may not know. Each part can be turned off in /thimble-settings or /config.

observer.title: Observer
observer.description: After each of Claude's messages, a side agent reads it with the whole session and gives the parts that are on. One call per message, over the session Claude already has cached.

notes.title: Observer: notes to Claude
notes.description: Up to two notes Claude reads with your next prompt, such as a number that counts the wrong months. You do not see them. A small part of each look.

visualize.title: Observer: v proposals
visualize.description: Lights v with a named view when a view would show what the answer only tells. A small part of each look.

explain.title: Observer: explainers
explain.description: Marks the terms of an answer you may not know; ] opens what each one means here. A small part of each look.

details.title: Observer: important details
details.description: Marks the details of an answer that are easy to miss and change what it means. A small part of each look.

squeeze.title: Observer: squeeze levels
squeeze.description: Says where each answer stands on squeeze's chips, so your first change with s starts from the right level. A few words of each look.

claims.title: Observer: claims
claims.description: Keeps the session's claims in the Claims pane, with c and the claims count on the bar. The largest part of each look.

catchup.title: Catch-up
catchup.description: When two or more replies came since your last prompt, s offers to catch up on all of them in one. Nothing until you press s: then one rewrite of the replies.

coverage.title: Coverage count on the bar
coverage.description: Shows on the bar how much of the data Claude read (seen 12%); r opens Coverage. No model call: thimble counts the files after each turn.

labels.title: Labels count on the bar
labels.description: Shows on the bar how many labels the folder has; l opens them. No model call.
